questions.question: Which fix shape should BUG-315 take?

options.label: Bind in fixture (Recommended)
options.description: Call werkzeug make_server('127.0.0.1', 0, moto app) in the fixture thread, then serve_forever in a daemon thread. Closes the race AND the hang: a bind failure raises immediately. Depends on moto's DomainDispatcherApplication (internal-ish import).

options.label: Dossier fix: port=0
options.description: ThreadedMotoServer(ip_address='127.0.0.1', port=0) + get_host_and_port(). Smallest diff, public moto API. Closes the race; a bind failure would still hang start() forever (now very unlikely).

options.label: port=0 + bounded wait
options.description: Dossier fix, but start() runs in a helper that joins with a timeout and fails the session by name if the server never becomes ready. Closes both; more code than option 1.

questions.question: What should this session do next?

options.label: Implement now (Recommended)
options.description: Orient + trace, update dossier with the reproduced evidence, failing test first, fix, CHANGELOG, backlog close, on branch worktree-bug-315.

options.label: Update dossier only
options.description: Record the reproductions (P1-P5, excluded port ranges, Linux EADDRINUSE path) in the dossier and index entry; no fix yet.

options.label: Stop at analysis
options.description: Leave the repo untouched.

questions.question: benchmarks/conftest.py moto_url has the same choose-release-bind pattern and hang. Benchmarks never import from tests/; both import infra/ (infra/_settings.py calls itself the loader 'for the test suite, benchmarks, and any other Python caller'). How should the benchmark copy be fixed?

options.label: Shared helper in infra/ (Recommended)
options.description: Move _start_moto_server to infra/_moto.py (start_moto_server); tests/conftest.py and benchmarks/conftest.py both use it. One home for the bind-once + SystemExit→OSError logic. Test file imports from infra. Wider diff (new module in infra/).

options.label: Inline fix in benchmarks
options.description: Apply the same make_server('127.0.0.1', 0) pattern inside moto_url and fix its docstring. Smallest change, but two copies of the workaround that can drift.

options.label: File a follow-up
options.description: Leave benchmarks unchanged in this PR; mint a new BUG item for moto_url and record it in the dossier/trace. Benchmark hang stays open until then.

questions.question: CODE_PAT now gets ^infra/[^/]+\.py$ (the reviewer's ask, matching bucket-rules.md:74). infra/.env and infra/docker-compose.yml are unclassified siblings: they feed infra._settings and CI's docker run, and their guard check_infra_settings sits in CODE_PAT-gated lint, so an .env-only PR runs neither. How far should this PR go?

options.label: Only infra/*.py, file rest (Recommended)
options.description: Keep this PR to the measured case (Python imported by tests/conftest.py). Mint a new BUG item for infra/.env and docker-compose.yml matching no CI class; the reply names it. Keeps BUG-315 from growing a CI-routing decision.

options.label: Also add .env + compose
options.description: Widen the pattern to ^infra/([^/]+\.py|\.env|docker-compose\.yml)$ now. Closes the class in one PR, but routes a config-only edit through the full code fan-out, a CI-cost call no measurement backs yet.

options.label: Only infra/*.py, no item
options.description: Mention the sibling in the reply and trace only. No backlog item, so nothing tracks it.

questions.question: Round 3: the three research/RFC measurement scripts still carry the choose-then-bind pattern, and one is cited as the probe template. How should /fix-pr close it?

options.label: Dossier note (Recommended)
options.description: Add a dated line to the BUG-315 dossier naming the three scripts (5 sites), saying they are left as records, and pointing new probes at infra/_moto.start_moto_server. Scripts stay byte-identical to what they measured.

options.label: Repoint the template only
options.description: Dossier note as above, plus switch research-s3-error-mapping-fidelity.py (the cited template) to start_moto_server. Changes a dated research record so future copies start clean.

options.label: Fix all three scripts
options.description: Switch all five sites to start_moto_server. Reverses the earlier scope decision; the scripts would no longer be exactly what produced their recorded results.

questions.question: bug-315-moto-port-race is 1 commit behind origin/master. Rebase onto it and force-push (--force-with-lease) before this fix pass's push?

options.label: Rebase and force-push (Recommended)
options.description: Commit the decision-log tail, git rebase origin/master, push --force-with-lease, then add the dossier note on top. Keeps the PR's final head current with master.

options.label: Don't rebase
options.description: Add the dossier note on the current base and push fast-forward. The PR stays 1 commit behind; GitHub's merge handles it if there's no conflict.
